title: Qualcomm forecast falls short as Apple sales disappear
text: Qualcomm forecast falls short as Apple sales disappear Wednesday, 7 November 2018 ( 20 minutes ago ) Qualcomm Inc forecast current-quarter revenue below analysts' estimates on Wednesday as it took a hit from the loss of chip sales to Apple Inc , sending its shares down 2.5 percent. The company made the annoucement Thursday.
